description: This file implements a semantic version comparison package, including functions for validation, canonicalization, version component extraction, comparison, and sorting of semantic version strings following Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 with specific conventions.

classes.name: parsed
classes.description: Struct representing the parsed components of a semantic version string.

classes.name: ByVersion
classes.description: Type implementing sort.Interface for sorting semantic version strings.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if a version string is valid according to semantic versioning rules.

methods.name: Canonical
methods.description: Returns the canonical form of a semantic version string, filling in missing parts and discarding build metadata.

methods.name: Major
methods.description: Extracts the major version prefix from a version string.

methods.name: MajorMinor
methods.description: Extracts the major.minor version prefix from a version string.

methods.name: Prerelease
methods.description: Returns the prerelease suffix of a version string.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Returns the build suffix of a version string.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares two semantic version strings according to precedence rules.

methods.name: Max
methods.description: Returns the greater of two version strings after canonicalization (deprecated).

methods.name: Sort
methods.description: Sorts a list of semantic version strings.
